0 REM  SPRITEMAKER BY SELLAM ABRAHAM
10 TEXT : HOME
20 DIM P2(7): FOR X = 0 TO 6:P2(X) = 2 ^ X: NEXT X
30 BASE = 32768: REM SPRITE TABLE BASE ADDRESS
40 ST = BASE + 256: REM SPRITE TABLE BASE
45 SE = ST + 2: REM SET ADDRESS FOR FIRST SPRITE TABLE ENTRY
50 SD = BASE + 512: REM SPRITE DATA BASE ADDRESS
60 READ NS: REM  NUMBER OF SPRITES
70 PRINT "SPRITE TABLE MAKER": PRINT
80 PRINT NS;" SPRITES TO COMPILE": PRINT
100 FOR S = 1 TO NS
101 PRINT "COMPILING SPRITE #";S;" OF ";NS: PRINT
105 READ W,H: REM GET WIDTH & HEIGHT
110 REM CREATE SPRITE TABLE ENTRY
115 POKE SE,W: POKE SE + 1,H
120 POKE SE + 2,SD - ( INT (SD / 256) * 256): POKE SE + 3, INT (SD / 256)
123 SE = SE + 4
125 FOR Y = 1 TO H
130 P =  INT ((Y / H) * 100):I = 1
140 READ B$: REM GET BITS
150 FOR X = 1 TO W
160 V = 0
170 FOR B = 0 TO 6
175 BIT =  VAL ( MID$ (B$,I,1))
180 V = V + BIT * P2(B)
185 PRINT BIT;
190 I = I + 1
200 NEXT B
210 POKE SD,V: REM STORE SPRITE DATA
220 SD = SD + 1
230 NEXT X
240 PRINT " - ";P;"%"
250 NEXT Y
260 PRINT "DONE": PRINT
270 NEXT S
300 REM  FINALIZE SPRITE TABLE
310 POKE ST,NS: REM NUMBER OF SPRITES
320 POKE ST + 1,4: REM TABLE ENTRY WIDTH (DO NOT CHANGE)
350 PRINT : PRINT NS;" SPRITES COMPILED"
360 PRINT "TABLE LENGTH: ";SD - ST;" BYTES": PRINT
370 PRINT "SAVE TABLE? (Y/N) ";
380 GET Q$
390 IF Q$ <  > "Y" THEN  PRINT "N": GOTO 500
395 PRINT "Y"
400 INPUT "ENTER TABLE NAME: ";N$
410 IF  LEN (N$) > 15 THEN  PRINT "NAME TOO LONG, TRY AGAIN": GOTO 400
420 IF  LEN (N$) = 0 THEN  PRINT "CANCELLED": GOTO 500
430 PRINT  CHR$ (4);"BSAVE ";N$;",A$8100,L";(SD - ST)
500 PRINT : PRINT "SPRITE COMPILATION COMPLETE"
510 END
900 REM  SPRITE DATA STRUCTURE
905 REM
910 REM  EACH STRUCTURE STARTS
915 REM  WITH THE WIDTH AND
920 REM  HEIGHT OF THE SPRITE.
925 REM
930 REM  EXAMPLE: DATA 2,10
935 REM  THE SPRITE IS 2 BYTES
940 REM  WIDE BY 10 LINES HIGH.
945 REM
950 REM  BYTES ARE 7-BITS WIDE
955 REM  AND DO NOT INCLUDE THE
960 REM  HI-BIT. THE COLOR BIT
965 REM  IS NOT SUPPORTED AT
970 REM  THE PRESENT TIME.
975 REM
980 REM  PIXEL DATA MUST BE IN
985 REM  MULTIPLES OF 7 BITS.
990 REM  1=PIXEL AND 0=NO PIXEL
995 REM  DATA MUST BE EXACT
999 REM
1000 REM  BEGINNING OF SPRITE DATA
1001 REM  NUMBER OF SPRITES
1002 DATA 13
